item.name: VIEWFINDER
item.label: Creative tool
item.description: Viewfinder is a personal, browser-based studio for turning screenshots and screen recordings into polished 3D product photos and videos. You drop in a screen, set the camera angle, lens blur, lighting and backdrop, and export a PNG or video rendered by the same code as the preview. Everything runs locally with no server or accounts.

blocks.caption: EDITOR — DROP IN A SCREEN, SET THE SHOT.
HERO ANGLE — ONE CLICK, A NEW CAMERA.
